newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hitachi Zosen aims for same profits.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi Zosen aims for same profits.

text.p: Hitachi Zosen Singapore Ltd said on Friday its turnover fell in its financial year to March 31, 1997 due to a drop in revenue from shipbuilding.

The company said in a statement it managed to turn in a higher profit because of better returns from investment and interest income as well as from higher than expected turnover from shiprepair in the second half.
It did not expect significant improvement in shiprepair market in the current year but hoped to maintain the same level of profitability.
The company earlier reported a net profit of Singapore $7.17 million, up 13.9 percent on the previous year.
